claims: The 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament Final Four is in Indianapolis.
UConn Huskies are the #2 seed from the East region in the 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament Final Four.
Illinois Fighting Illini are the #3 seed from the South region in the 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament Final Four.
Arizona Wildcats are the #1 seed from the West region in the 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament Final Four.
Michigan Wolverines are the #1 seed from the Midwest region in the 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament Final Four.
The 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament Final Four matchups are scheduled for Saturday, April 4, 2026.
One 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament Final Four matchup is #2 UConn Huskies vs. #3 Illinois Fighting Illini.
One 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament Final Four matchup is #1 Arizona Wildcats vs. #1 Michigan Wolverines.
UConn Huskies defeated Duke 73-72 in the Elite Eight.
UConn Huskies' Elite Eight victory was led by a last-second 3-pointer.
Illinois Fighting Illini reached the Final Four with a 71-59 victory over Iowa.
Arizona Wildcats reached the Final Four after beating Purdue 79-64.
Arizona Wildcats reached their first Final Four in 25 years.
Michigan Wolverines defeated Tennessee 95-62 to advance to the Final Four.
